summary: This joint resolution blocks the EPA rule titled 'Review of Final Rule Reclassification of Major Sources as Area Sources Under Section 112 of the Clean Air Act' (89 Fed. Reg. 73293) from taking effect.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly nullifies an EPA rule designed to maintain emission standards for hazardous air pollutants, which would lead to less environmental protection. The entire purpose of the bill is to undo an environmental regulation.
